Build your first workflow

  1. Pick one task

    Choose a repeatable job like organizing inquiries, drafting social posts, or putting together a weekly report.

  2. Practice on sample data

    Write a short brief with the goal, audience, source material, and expected output. Use fictional client details.

  3. Review and document

    Check the result against the brief. Record the steps, review points, and what you would hand off to a client.

AI skills library

Each entry explains what the skill helps with and gives you something to try.

Operations

Prompting and briefing

Give an assistant the context, constraints, and format it needs to draft useful work.

Try it · Draft three inquiry replies from an invented business’s FAQ, then verify the answers against the FAQ.

Operations

SOP writing

Turn rough process notes into instructions that a teammate can follow.

Try it · Write an intake checklist with owners, handoffs, and an exception path.

Operations

CRM and workflow automation

Map how leads move from inquiry to follow-up and identify steps that could run automatically.

Try it · Design a lead handoff with duplicate checks and approval before a message is sent.

Marketing

Social media planning

Turn one offer into a week of content ideas, captions, and publishing notes.

Try it · Build a three-post campaign for a fictional bakery and check that every offer detail matches the brief.

Marketing

SEO research and reporting

Group search topics by intent and turn verified performance data into a useful report.

Try it · Outline a local cleaning service page and identify which search terms need validation.

Marketing

AI image and video workflows

Develop campaign visuals, storyboards, and video concepts from a brand brief.

Try it · Create a storyboard for a 15-second café promo and check text, brand colors, and visual consistency.

Web

AI-assisted website building

Use a coding assistant to create a draft site and refine it with a clear design brief.

Try it · Build a sample service page and check mobile layout, keyboard navigation, and form states.

Trends to watch

AI that works across formats

Practice turning one source brief into copy, a visual, and a storyboard. Check that prices, dates, and claims match across all three.

AI connected to business tools

Learn how assistants use information from tools like CRMs and shared documents. Start with sample data and review permissions before connecting a client account.

Review steps in automation

Learn where a person should approve an action, especially before publishing, emailing a customer, or updating a record.
